symptom: The bounded Proxy preflight treated a repeated object reference as safe even when it was an active ancestor. A synthetic self-referential own-data object passed preflight and caused recursive canonicalization to throw RangeError instead of returning a fail-closed validation result. This was reproduced offline with Node 22.16.0; no real SQLite or production evidence was accessed.
lesson: A visited-set check is not a cycle detector. Repeated acyclic aliases and active ancestor references must be distinguished before canonical recursive hashing.
guardrail: Use an active-ancestor stack plus a separate bounded visited list for own-data preflight; deny cycles before canonical digest, preserve shared acyclic references, and regress both with synthetic inputs. No external issuer, settlement, scoring or production authority follows.
